items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Issue 972 item 3 only: stderr warning naming traceability.test_roots when no test folder resolves, and a gate message that says no tagged test was scanned instead of asking for new tests. Profile-declared roots (items 1/2) are deliberately a separate iterate.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Warning is diagnostic only, resolution unchanged; the note helper never raises and falls back to the original advice on a malformed manifest.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The warning prints the project root path and the fixed default folder names; configured test_roots entries are never echoed back (asserted by a test).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 6 collector tests (nested layout, once per root, conventional silent, configured silent, configured-matching-nothing, per-root) and 8 gate tests (no link, linked, orphan, untagged, malformed, default arg).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One set lookup per resolution and one pass over the already built manifest, only on a failing gate.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Helper moved into _layer_coverage_scan_note.py so layer_coverage.py stays at 278 lines (cap 300); _test_links_io.py 290.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; the manifest schema is untouched and the warning goes to stderr only.
